positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
• Led end-to-end development of Store Mode initiatives including Remodel, Locate View, Out of Stock, and Geofenced location, authoring discovery documents, creating Jira tickets, and driving implementation from design to delivery.

• Owned the LocateView Redesign from technical discovery through release, improving how millions of guests locate items in-store and proactively escalating cross-team API review blockers to keep the project on schedule.

• Implemented paginated product listing pages using Jetpack Compose LazyColumn and Paging 3, loading store-tailored and search-driven product results on demand to optimize memory usage and scroll performance at scale.

• Cross-collaborated with the CDUI platform team to integrate a config-driven UI layout system into Store Mode,
documented the integration approach, and shared implementation guidance to reduce onboarding friction for future engineers.

• Built Store Mode features using Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Kotlin Flow and StateFlow for reactive state management, Jetpack Navigation, Hilt/Dagger for dependency injection, and Retrofit for RESTful API integration.

• Wrote unit tests with JUnit using fake Hilt modules to isolate ViewModel logic, and authored Compose UI tests and snapshot tests to validate rendering accuracy and prevent visual regressions across Store Mode screens.

• Led user testing sessions to evaluate new Store Mode features, gathering qualitative feedback to refine UX, improve navigation, and ensure seamless performance in real-world store environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a restful API from scratch that allows warehouse workers to see shifts and schedules with different types of keys. (Kotlin, PostgreSQL, Micronaut, flyway, jOOQ)

• Developed quality test cases for the API and learned how to test for better analysis and testing of the production system. (Insomnia and DBeaver)

• Learned the Agile process and Jira software to track progress over sprints and improve the effectiveness of the team’s software development.

• Utilized git to pull and merge my individual changes on files to allow collaboration with others.

positions.title: Student Library Assistant
positions.description:
• Accurately maintained records of patrons records through Microsoft Excel.

• Assisted patrons with various questions and concerns related to their accounts and books.

• Carry out library shelving and processing mail for the library.

• Investigate and resolve patron complaints in a timely manner.

• Guarantee a positive experience for patrons.
